CATEGORY: 为了 + VP. (Coherence: connectors)
definition: Use 为了 + verb phrase to state a purpose, in the appropriate clause position; do not use it as a result connector.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (4 distinct):
1 | 为了 + VP.
1 | it is loosely connected with the previous sentence, better add “为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物”, 神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物，“过” is to express “experience”, now the experience has not yet been experienced
1 | “所以” is inappropriate because here is not a result, delete it, add “为了找到没有毒的植物”
1 | “为了……” cannot be in the latter clause

HER CORRECTIONS (5 of 5):
[mengmu_samples#3/f3/p0/k0/e1] 他们搬家不是为了孟母[-要]住在更好的房子  || her note: 为了 + VP.
[shennong_samples#1/f2/p0/note/e0] [+为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物，]神农旅行了  || her note: it is loosely connected with the previous sentence, better add “为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物”, 神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物，“过” is to express “experience”, now the experience has not yet been experienced
[shennong_samples#38/f2/p0/note/e1] [+为了找到没有毒的植物，]所以他去了又空又高的山  || her note: “所以” is inappropriate because here is not a result, delete it, add “为了找到没有毒的植物”
[mengmu_samples#48/f0/p0/k0-1/e0] [每次搬家她都辛苦地工作，为了给孟子提供更好的学习环境→为了给孟子提供更好的学习环境，每次搬家她都辛苦地工作]  || her note: “为了……” cannot be in the latter clause
[shennong_samples#44/f2/p0/k0/e0] [都为了→只是]找到治病的方法

output.rule: Use 为了 + VP. to state a purpose, usually before the main clause. Do not use 为了 as a result connector, and do not put the 为了 phrase in the latter clause.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <purpose> is the purpose of <main action>, so use 为了 + <VP> before the main clause; do not use 所以 to show a result here.

examples.explanation: 为了孟母要住在更好的房子 → 为了孟母住在更好的房子: use 为了 + VP.; the purpose phrase is 孟母住在更好的房子.
神农旅行了 → 为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物，神农旅行了: add 为了 + VP. to show the purpose of the trip.
所以他去了又空又高的山 → 为了找到没有毒的植物，他去了又空又高的山: finding non-poisonous plants is the purpose, not a result, so do not use 所以.
每次搬家她都辛苦地工作，为了给孟子提供更好的学习环境 → 为了给孟子提供更好的学习环境，每次搬家她都辛苦地工作: the 为了 phrase cannot be in the latter clause.

output.not_an_error: Do not flag 为了 when it correctly introduces a purpose before the main clause. If the meaning is a result, do not use 为了 for that connection.
